svg.title: The separately constructed adaptive four-copy policy has a certified ideal error strictly below 1/32. The preceding lower bound therefore covers every continuous nonadaptive competitor, rather than only the old X/Y menu or selected fixed-angle designs. This is a genuine continuous-access feedback separation under the stated preparation and record contract. At the explicitly selected tolerance 0.031, the exhibited adaptive policy passes with four copies. Every nonadaptive reader with at most four copies fails by the 1/32 bound and monotonicity. A five-copy repeated bisector has error 1/2 −(43/128) √
